column1: # Heart (Chalice), the Kolima secret boss. Also names rows 101 and 104.

column3: Matthew...\nYou came back.\nLook what you made of me.{end_wait}
I'm Isaac.\nMatthew is my son.\nYou've mistaken me.{end_wait}
No. I know that face.\nI remember my defeat.\nAnd what came after.{end_wait}
This face... this body...\nI paid for that failure.\nNow you will pay.{end_wait}
I won't fail again.\nNot against you, Matthew.\nNot this time.{end_wait}
I'm not your enemy.\nBut I won't let you\nhurt anyone else.{end_wait}
No... Not again...\nAfter everything...\nAfter what I became...{end_wait}
It's over.\nYou can't keep fighting.\nI'm not Matthew.{end_wait}

Liar... I know those eyes.
That same damned face...{page_break}I lost my pride.
My face. Everything.
I will never forgive you.{end_wait}
You don't get to decide.\nRemember this, Matthew.\nWe will meet again.{end_wait}
